pages.title: Dashboard
pages._note: DashboardIndex is a self-contained view that renders a single CnDashboardPage (KPI cards + recent-activity list + quick-anonymization panel). It is mounted via type:"custom" so only one CnDashboardPage renders — wrapping it as a body widget of a type:"dashboard" page nested CnDashboardPage-in-CnDashboardPage (hydra dashboard-antipattern).

pages.title: Consent Management
pages._note: Consent objects are fetched from docudesk's own PHP controller (not a plain OR index endpoint) and rendered via CnIndexPage with custom column formatters; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Consent Detail
pages._note: Detail fetched via consent store; sidebar driven by navigationStore.selected. Uses custom layout; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Anonymization
pages._note: Anonymization uses the anonymization store (docudesk API) not OpenRegister; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Folder Analysis
pages._note: Folder-level anonymization scan; fetches via folderAnonymizationStore (docudesk API); type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Templates
pages._note: Templates are managed by docudesk's own template controller. Future ADR may migrate to OR-backed index if a template schema is registered.

pages.title: Template Detail
pages._note: Template detail view with lock/unlock, editor, and preview. Hybrid data path via templateStore.

pages.title: Signing Requests
pages._note: Signing requests are managed by docudesk's signing controller; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Signing Request Detail
pages._note: Signing request detail view driven by signingStore.

pages.title: My Documents
pages._note: Hosts the in-app file viewer (FileViewerPage renders when fileViewerStore.currentFile is set). The anonymisation widget routes here after upload so the user reviews detected entities next to the document contents.

pages.title: Print Preview
pages._note: Standalone print-preview page; no nav item; launched programmatically.
